summary: NAVIGATION FOUNDATION PASS 1 verified end-to-end. Fresh onboarding with ONLY Boston Bruins (WHL/OHL/QMJHL/NCAA NOT followed) — confirmed via localStorage.ticker.follows containing only {abbr:'BOS'}. From Home, nav-hockey opens /hockey with all sections: NHL (National Hockey League), CHL group (WHL/OHL/QMJHL), and NCAA. OHL hub loads and shows league-parent-chl chip; tapping it returns to Hockey World; from there WHL hub loads and league-team-KAM (Kamloops Blazers, never followed) opens fully with roster/scorers/next game. Universal search (nav-search -> search-input) with 'Boston University' returns a NCAA result whose stable id navigates to /team/BU?league=ncaa loading the Terriers page (never followed — follows still only BOS after tapping). NCAA -> nav-hockey -> Hockey World -> world-league-nhl loads NHL hub with 32 teams and any team opens. FollowPill on Kamloops team page toggles FOLLOW -> FOLLOWING -> FOLLOW; same verified on a Kamloops player page reached via 'Leading the Way' (both were NOT pre-followed). BackBar shows nav-hockey + nav-search + back-button on every detail route; OUT rail (out-home/out-recap/out-tonight/out-stats) present on team and league detail routes. Regression: from a WHL team page tapping out-recap shows WHL context (kicker 'WHL' present in body). Top tabs (toptab-home/recap/tonight/stats) still switch and HOME remains global. ALL acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: app/hockey.tsx: clean, purely additive; PARENTS constant is well-scoped and 'others' fallback handles unknown leagues gracefully.

app/search.tsx: navigates by stable id + league (team_abbr / player_id + league_code) as intended; NHL kept clean of query string; NCAA/WHL/OHL/QMJHL correctly include ?league=<code>. 250ms debounce and runId guard are correct.
app/team/[id].tsx BackBar exports both back-button and nav-hockey/nav-search icons — reused by /hockey, /search, /league, /player. Consistent global entry.
components/ui.tsx FollowPill uses testID='follow-toggle' and label swaps FOLLOW <-> FOLLOWING via internal state via useFollows — behavior verified as toggle-only (no gating).
lib/follows.tsx toggleTeam/togglePlayer default tier=2 for new follows and preserve existing entries; onboarded flag is untouched by these toggles so no accidental re-onboarding.
app/league/[code].tsx: league-parent-chl chip only renders for whl/ohl/qmjhl (correct); navigates to /hockey?parent=chl, matching the highlight prop consumed by hockey.tsx.

Stack routing keeps prior screens mounted-hidden which means bare testID selectors match multiple DOM nodes across the stack. All tests here use visible=true filter — main agent's testIDs are fine, but future test agents must filter for visibility.
